why: 3:18-19 says Christ was made alive "in the spirit". Some, like the KJV ("by the Spirit"), read this as the Holy Spirit, but many take it as a realm or way of life rather than the Spirit by name; the views are in the chapter's notes.
4:14 names "the Spirit of glory, the Spirit of God" resting on believers; Bible Atlas does not link the Holy Spirit in this chapter.

Most readers, from the early church on, take "Babylon" in 5:13 as a code name for Rome; others take it as the city in Mesopotamia or a Roman fort in Egypt. Because the place is disputed, no dot is drawn at the Mesopotamian city.
